---
title: "Cars - selectInput"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- mpg
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("var", "Group by", choices = c("class", "drv", "fl"))
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Highway mpg
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Count
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Cars
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[input$var]], y = hwy)) + geom_boxplot())
})
output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[input$var]])) + geom_bar())
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(df))
```
